title: Credo (Renaldo, Missa Sine nomine (Bologna Q19))
desc: Renaldo, Missa Sine nomine (Bologna Q19), Credo. 4 voices (Superius, Altus, Tenor, Bassus), each on its own staff. Source: Bologna Q19. No text in this edition.
